name: PantryPal
one_liner: Snap a photo of your fridge, get 3 recipes.
problem: People waste food and time because they don't know what to cook with what they already have.
audience: Busy home cooks and students with a half-empty fridge.

features.name: Fridge scan
features.description: Detects ingredients from one photo of the open fridge.

features.name: Three recipes
features.description: Suggests three recipes ranked by how many of your ingredients they use.

features.name: Shopping list
features.description: Lists the few missing ingredients for a chosen recipe.
